gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.bezig_jij: Catch them, guhtje! Do you want to stop?
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.hallo.0: Psst, quietly! The glowworms flutter about here. Catch them with my net and put them in the jar on your back. Your records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.hallo.1: A golden glowworm is five times as glimmery! Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.hallo.2: The more you catch, the brighter my hall. I like reading in bed, you see? Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.glimwormvangen.uitleg: You have 60 seconds. Swing your net (right-click) at the glowworms right in front of you, or tap them. Some are quick, some hide in the glow bushes. A golden glowworm is 5 points. Every catch goes in the jar on your back, and the more you catch, the brighter the jar and the hall. Hard: more and quicker glowworms, and it starts darker.
gui.guhs.grotspel.bezig: %s is playing right now. Watch for a bit, or have a look in my shop!
gui.guhs.grotspel.no_build: No rebuilding, guhtje: this is a game hall!
gui.guhs.kledingbron.lichtjespuzzel: The Little Lights Puzzle (in the cave)
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.balk: Lamps on %s/%s  |  jumps %s (can be done in %s)  |  %s
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.bezig_jij: Jump, jump! Do you want to stop?
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hallo.0: Oh dear, my toadstool lamps are all mixed up! Jump on a lamp: it switches, and so do its four neighbours. Switch them all on, so I can read my paper again. Your records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hallo.1: One more lamp is one more guh! Or something like that. Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hallo.2: Think first, then jump! Fewer jumps is more coins. Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.uitleg: The big raster has 7 by 7 lamps. Jump on a lamp (or crouch on it): it and its four neighbours switch, on becomes off and off becomes on. Switch them ALL on before the time is up. Every puzzle can be done, and I know the fewest jumps it takes: the closer you get to that and the faster you are, the more lamp coins. Hard: a trickier puzzle and less time.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.bezig_jij: Dig, dig, guhtje! Do you want to stop?
gui.guhs.schatgraven.hallo.0: Ahoy, guhtje! Treasure lies buried under this fluff field. Grab my soft shovel and dig it up! Sniffy helps you sniff. Your records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.hallo.1: Guhrrr! I mean: arrr! Who's digging up my treasure today? Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.hallo.2: Watch out for the squeaky cheese, it squeaks your time away! But a golden cheese... wahoog! Records: easy %s, medium %s, hard %s.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.rust: That bit isn't part of the game now.
gui.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.veld: Sniffy: onto the field first, guhtje!
gui.guhs.schatgraven.uitleg: You have 90 seconds. Right-click (or left-click) the fluff field with the soft shovel to dig a spot open. Sniffy sniffs along: COLD, warm or HOT (then he jumps!). Every treasure is 10 points, the golden cheese 25, a squeaky cheese costs you 10 seconds. Found everything? Then the seconds left count too! Easy: a small field and lots of help from Sniffy. Hard: the whole field, and Sniffy sniffs less often.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.glimwormvangen.waar: Deep under a pink hut in the Guhmension: Miss Glimmy's dark hall.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.lichtjespuzzel.waar: Deep under a pink hut in the Guhmension: Master Blinky's lamp hall.
gui.guhs.spelgroep.schatgraven.waar: Deep under a pink hut in the Guhmension: jump on the cloud lift, down to Captain Shovelsnout.
item.guhs.glimnetje.lore: Right-click: swing your net at the glowworms right in front of you.
item.guhs.glimpotje_rug.lore: The more glowworms in it, the brighter it glows.
item.guhs.schatschepje.lore: Right-click or left-click the treasure field to dig. Soft, because the field is fluff.
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.hoe: Right-click with the net: you catch the glowworms right in front of you.
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.oordeel_aardig: Lovely! I can see my toes again.
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.oordeel_goed: What a light! Now I can finally finish my book. Thank you, guhtje!
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.oordeel_oefene: It's still a bit dark... but it is cosy!
quest.guhs.glimwormvangen.start: Net ready, jar on your back, %s! Shhh... 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.grotspel.bezig: %s is playing right now. Just a moment, guhtje!
quest.guhs.grotspel.cadeautje: Your very first game! A present: 16 cheese nibbles and something nice for your home.
quest.guhs.grotspel.eerste_record: Your first score on this level: %s!
quest.guhs.grotspel.elders: You're still busy with another game! Finish that one first.
quest.guhs.grotspel.gestopt: Stopped. No points this time, but a hug.
quest.guhs.grotspel.huis_record: The record of the whole world! Your name is at the top of the board.
quest.guhs.grotspel.kapot: Oops... my hall is broken. I can't run a game like this.
quest.guhs.grotspel.vol: Your pockets are full! Make some room for your things.
quest.guhs.grotspel.weggelopen: You walked away! The game is over.
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.hoe: Jump on a lamp (or crouch on it): it and its neighbours switch. Every lamp on = done!
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.oordeel_aardig: Well done! It's nice and bright in here again.
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.oordeel_goed: Everything on! I can read my paper again. It says you're very clever!
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.oordeel_oefene: Hmm, still a few dark spots. Try again, guhtje!
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.start: A new puzzle, %s! Look closely, think... 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.lichtjespuzzel.uitslag: Solved in %s jumps (it could be done in %s)
quest.guhs.schatgraven.hoe: Right-click the field with the shovel to dig. Sniffy beeps: cold, warm, HOT.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.oordeel_aardig: Nicely dug, guhtje! Sniffy wags his tail.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.oordeel_goed: Arrr! You're a real treasure guh! I'll fill the field in again.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.oordeel_oefenen: Oh well, the treasure is still there. Next time listen to Sniffy better!
quest.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.0: Sniff sniff! Do you smell cheese too?
quest.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.1: I'm Sniffy. My nose is my shovel!
quest.guhs.schatgraven.snuffie.2: Squeaky cheese smells nice too... that's the problem.
quest.guhs.schatgraven.start: Arrr, %s! Sniffy is already sniffing. Ready? 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.schatgraven.uitslag_geen_goud: The golden cheese stayed hidden (that would have been %s points)
quest.guhs.schatgraven.uitslag_niet_alle: Not everything found: no time bonus
structure.guhs.grotspel_glimwormen.toolt: Cave minigame: catch glowworms with Miss Glimmy, glimmer coins and glowworm feelers
structure.guhs.grotspel_lichtjes.tooltip: Cave minigame: switch on every toadstool lamp with Master Blinky, lamp coins and a glowing hat
structure.guhs.grotspel_schatgraven.tool: Cave minigame: dig up treasure with Captain Shovelsnout and Sniffy, treasure coins and a pirate outfit
